jules: rolling rwdv9-int4 to 1% as a narrow canary. goal: validate versioning tags and auto-fallback hooks.
maya: what's the exact autofallback rule?
jules: short: if delta_MRR <= -1.0pp OR halluc_rate_delta >= 0.8pp OR composite_risk > 0.018 -> immediate fallback. composite_risk = 0.5*abs(MRR_delta) + 0.4*halluc_rate_delta + 0.1*(p99_ms/1000).
sam: add a hard rerank parity check: rerank_precision_drop > 1.2pp => immediate rollback regardless. also require sustained signal: violation in 3/4 consecutive 1m buckets.
maya: cohort seeding: longctx, low-resource-lang, rerank-edge (3% each). require min 500 samples per cohort in first 3h.
deploy-bot: canary start @1712348010 traffic=1% variant=rwdv9-int4
qa-bot: initial smoke (500 samples): MRR_delta = -0.002 (-0.2pp), halluc_rate_delta = +0.003 (+0.3pp), p99 +9ms -> composite_risk ~ 0.005. No alerts.
jules: good. will wire model git-sha and quant metadata into incident payload. ping when we hit 10k samples.
maya: I'll keep the alert thresholds conservative. If composite_risk > 0.01 then page.
sam: ack. logging trace ids for diffs.
jules: thanks all, will post rollout record link after 2h.
